quote: My heart is moved by all I cannot save: / so much has been destroyed / I have to cast my lot with those / who age after age, perversely, / with no extraordinary power, / reconstitute the world.
source: Adrienne Rich, Natural Resources, closing six lines, The Dream of a Common Language (W. W. Norton, 1978)
